objects.description: One obliquely drawn upright quadrangular prism, with corresponding bottom A,B,C,D and top A1,B1,C1,D1 vertices.
Top quadrilateral A1 B1 C1 D1; D1 lies behind A1; C1 above-right of B1. Solid top perimeter and diagonal D1B1.
Bottom quadrilateral A B C D; A,B are front lower corners; C is right/rear; D is hidden left/rear. AB and BC solid; AD and DC dashed; DB diagonal dashed.
AA1, BB1, CC1 solid vertical edges, DD1 hidden/dashed.
Diagonal vertical quadrilateral D1 B1 B D is hatched; it shares top diagonal D1B1 and bottom diagonal DB with respective faces.
K lies on upper diagonal D1B1. Segment from C1 to K, and a small right-angle indication at K.
L lies on lower diagonal DB. Segment from C to L is dashed, with a small right-angle indication at L.
Dashed interior vertical segment from K towards L, inside the hatched section.

relationships: A/A1, B/B1, C/C1, D/D1 are corresponding prism vertices.
K is on D1B1; C1K is perpendicular to D1B1 in the top face.
L is on DB; CL is perpendicular to DB in the bottom face.
K and L are corresponding feet under the prism's vertical translation.
D1B1BD is a shared diagonal section, not a separate floating rectangle.
Bottom/hidden construction segments remain dashed; visible top construction remains solid.
glyphDoubts: Small subscript 1 is clear as the common top-vertex suffix, not a different named vertex.
Small right-angle ink near K/L is crowded in the scan; exact stroke cosmetics are less certain than the foot-on-diagonal construction.
Some hidden dashes cross hatch strokes; do not invent additional points or an answer-bearing measurement.
